description: a corporate taco bell on the edge of downtown millbrook falls, squat between a parking lot and a drainage ditch. the sign buzzes just inside the front doors — one panel of the 'bell' flickers on the fritz. hard tile, a mop sign out on the wet floor, the hum of the place settling around you. from here the dining room sprawls left, the order counter sits straight ahead, and a long drive-thru lane wraps the far wall. the air is warm, greasy, and sweet with seasoned beef and cinnamon sugar.

environment.noise: kiosk beeps, soda machine hiss, drive-thru speaker
environment.smell: seasoned beef, crispy shell, cinnamon sugar

name: Taco Bell

exits.description: a wide open archway between lobby and seating, framed by the soda fountain island. traffic flows through it constantly during dinner rush; tonight it's just you and the hum.
glass double doors with a push bar, streaked with a hundred handprints. a taped paper sign reads COME BACK TOMORROW in marker, already ignored by everyone.
the customer side of the order counter, kiosk screens glowing at the end. the menu board looms overhead with its taped-over prices.
